sloka: सन्निपत्य च रक्षांसि दग्धशैलोपमो महान्।कुम्भकर्णो महावक्त्रः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६५.४३ ।।
transliteration: sannipatya ca rakṣāṁsi dagdhaśailopamo mahān।kumbhakarṇo mahāvaktraḥ prahasannidamabravīt ।। 6.65.43 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, furious Kumbhakarna said "Now I will consume all the battalions of Vanaras just as moths are consumed by fire."
